core_obligations: Construct the map on the defining ideal sheaves from the commutativity of the square.
Descend it to a map of conormal sheaves using the square-zero structure, and verify functoriality.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the two immersions and their defining ideal sheaves.
Construct the map of ideal sheaves and descend to conormal sheaves.

difficulty_reason: Given a commutative square of algebraic spaces whose horizontal arrows are immersions, the lemma produces a canonical map from the pullback of the conormal sheaf of the lower immersion to the conormal sheaf of the upper one. The proof constructs the map from the corresponding map of ideal sheaves, verifies it descends to the conormal sheaves via the square-zero structure, and checks compatibility with the pullback along the vertical arrows. Constructing the map on ideal sheaves and descending to conormal sheaves is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 473-517.
